biography.en: Hello, I am jwawind, a webcomics creator. Hope you enjoy reading this series.

description.en:
Cheon Jae‑beom seems like a comfortably above-average student: his parents spend 400 a month on private tutoring, he has a girlfriend, lots of friends, and grades that are better than most, so he confidently aims for a medical school spot in Seoul. 

When the college entrance exam goes badly, he ends up retaking the exam together with his girlfriend. Then, on the day before the second exam, his girlfriend suddenly breaks up with him. Crushed, Jae‑beom gives up on taking the test at all. 

The story follows what happens to his path afterward — how he deals with failure, lost love, and expectations, and what kind of future someone who fell off the elite track can still carve out for himself.
Sequel series to Aura from Another Planet.
Magical School Girl saved the world before, but doesn't know if she should save it again after what she's been through. Would you if you were in her shoes?

description.en: A collection of oneshots from comic.naver.com, ranging from romantic to horrifying from sweet to bittersweet love stories. These are true tales that happened to people in Korea.

Gi-Hyun encounters a talking chick one day. The talking chick, whose name is Bok, claims that Gi-Hyun is his master in their previous lives.  
  
Bok (The talking chick) has been reborn as a chicken in order to fullfil his duty which he failed in his previous life. His duty is to protect Gi-Hyun from the assassin who killed him in his previous life.  
  
And so, their ordeals begin.

Han Yu-ri lives a flawless double life: by day, he’s the invisible, glasses-wearing otaku at Jijon High; by night, he works a part-time job. But his peaceful routine shatters when Chan-wook, the school's most feared bully, falls head over heels for Yu-ri's part-timer persona—with absolutely no idea who he really is.

To make matters worse, the two are forced to pair up for a school learning program. As if hiding his identity from his new partner isn't stressful enough, Chan-wook’s best friend discovers Yu-ri's secret, throwing his life into absolute chaos. Now, Yu-ri must juggle a dangerous double life where getting caught means getting beaten up. Will he be able to graduate safely without Chan-wook ever finding out the truth?
The renter living in our house is a horrible (but beautiful) cat prince!

It's easier to make friends than breathing. 

After transferring school’s five times, he meets Lee Yoon-hwa, a girl of fate.The only way to target extreme ice goddess Lee Yoon-hwa is to use the reptile mania next to her!.

However, for Jung Joon, who has animal phobia, "Da Yeon, a reptile woman, was only an object of shock and fear.

Will Jung Joon be able to safely reach Yoon Hwa by harming the burdensome charm of rare pets that are coming at him from time to time?

There is a monster who lives in the deep woods and eats people. One day, the monster, missing a family member, meets a woman who is lost in the forest. Believing the woman to be like their mother, the monster has a plan to keep her near…

Set in the classical age of Korean history, a stubborn beautiful young lady finds herself one day out in the middle of nowhere… and to make things worse, she can't remember a thing! Her name, where she's from, and why she was almost about to drown in a pond. But fate would have it though, that a dashing young man with blonde hair and a wing for his right arm would rescue her.   
  
Somehow, deep down inside, this young man puts her at ease, and since she had lost all of her memories, she asks him to name her. With a face expressing the mixed emotions of sadness, remorse, and hope, he names her Bambi. Immediately, Bambi feels as though she has regained a part of herself as the name Bambi somehow feels so nostalgic. Especially the way the young man says her name… It almost feels as if she has known him since childhood…
Listen to the world's various stories on Yoo Si Ae's radio show, Cactus and Radio.

title.en: Contract Marriage with the Second Lead

altTitles.en: Second Male Lead, You Said It Was A Contract Marriage?

description.en: I possessed the body of Julieta Orvetian, a minor villainess destined to die over a few petty words. I successfully avoided the main cast until the story ended, finally securing my survival. But just as I prepared for a peaceful life, the second male lead, Yezar, appeared with a startling offer. “Would you be interested in a contract marriage?” I viewed it as a business deal and expected an easy divorce. However, as the contract period drew to a close, Yezar’s gentle mask began to slip. Only then did I realize he had never intended to let me go.

description.en:
Talent doesn't always run in the family.
In an age ruled by science, there remain almighty witches with mythical powers. However, Diana ended up lacking any of her mother's witchly talent. In fact, ever since she began training at the age of 7, her only goal was to reunite with her sister. But life never turns out how we want, does it?

description.en:
[!Warning!]

This imperial princess must live as a troublemaker, or disaster will strike.

I am this empire’s sole imperial princess, Vishnahel Loroi Kisomalos. Just moments ago, I was executed by gruesome torture and died, but with the help of my family’s god, I have returned to the age of five. To restore this utterly ruined empire and my family, I must recover the divine power of my family’s god, but the method is… to become human trash?

The more I live like a troublemaker, the more people with strong family gods gather around me, and our family’s divine status rises.

Time remaining: 16 years.

If I fail to restore my family’s god to its original state, I will be endlessly repeated the miserable torture execution.

Appointing a dark-haired new daddy, this is the story of a child growing up into a tyrant!

description.ru:
[!Внимание!] Если эта принцесса не будет жить как оторва, случится беда.

Я — единственная принцесса этой страны, Вишнаэль Лороуи Кисомалос.

Совсем недавно меня казнили через четвертование, и я умерла. Но благодаря помощи нашего домового бога я вернулась в прошлое — в своё пятилетнее тело.

Чтобы восстановить павшую страну и разрушенный род, мне необходимо вернуть силу нашего домового божества.
А способ… негодяйка!

Чем больше я буду вести себя как настоящая оторва и буянить, тем больше людей с подобными богами соберётся вокруг меня, и тем выше станет божественный ранг нашего рода.

Оставшееся время — 16 лет.
Если я не смогу вернуть нашего домового бога в прежнее состояние, мерзкая казнь через четвертование будет повторяться бесконечно.

История о том, как назначенный чёрноволосый отчим растит ребёнка, который постепенно превращается в настоящего тирана!

description.en: You must survive the fear of being eaten alive! A young man's struggle for survival in a world filled with zombies.

The world where you can see the future with a single picture has come!

Yoon Si-woo of the Future Development Corporation's Inhwa Team has a photo that means the death of the person in the photo,
Print 'Blackout'.

Shocking print results.
In order to change that person's future, Yoon Si-woo accepts a secret dispatch offer,
Dedicated to the printing of VIPs,
He gets access to the secret of future photography... .

Will Yoon Si-woo be able to change the darkened future?

"A woman is like a split apple on the side of the road. An apple that can be eaten by anyone and thrown away on the side of the road."   
With this thought about the world, can the 17-year-old high school girl, Kim Moon-young, really change?

Park Sang-woo joined the company with a dream of becoming a successful underwear designer. He joined the underwear design company of his dreams, but he became a prey for the boss because of his shy personality⋯. Sang-woo collapses day by day at the nasty joke that the water level rises more and more. And Mr. Byun Tae who enjoys that appearance♥ Will he be able to survive in the jungle of Yeocho?!
Survive for 3 years, perform 100 missions… If you can make it out, you can save your family.

This book contains three separate and unusual stories set in alternate realities. The first story, “How Martians Conquer the Earth,” tells the tale of a young woman struggling with the sudden death of the man she loves. Can anyone ever replace him? The second tale, “Is It Really Impossible?,” makes you wonder if a man and a woman can truly be just friends, especially in a world where women are such a rare find. And the last of the three, “Science Fiction Story,” is a sad tale about a girl who hates robots and the humanoid who serves her. The creator, who believes that the best privilege artists get is to ”lie,” creates a whole new world beyond your imagination.

description.en: Betrayed by her husband and forced to watch her family perish, Sohwa Tang, the brilliant Master of Poisons, exacts ruthless revenge before taking her own life. But death isn't the end. Awakening as her 17-year-old self, she makes a fierce vow: protect the Sichuan Tang clan at any cost. She doesn’t care about righteous justice or martial world politics. Her only goal is her family's survival. Yet as she brutally eliminates future threats, the world misinterprets her ruthless pragmatism as noble acts of chivalry. Follow Sohwa as she accidentally becomes the martial world’s greatest heroine while simply trying to keep her family alive.
description.fr: Tang So-hwa est une génie du poison qui connaît absolument tous les poisons existants sous le ciel, surnommée le "Maître de la Dissolution de Tous les Poisons" (Mandokhaesa). À la suite de la trahison de son mari — le chef de la famille/secte Namgoong —, sa propre famille est totalement exterminée. Seule survivante, So-hwa massacre la secte Namgoong à l'aide du poison avant de se suicider. Mais à peine a-t-elle fermé les yeux, après avoir accompli cette vengeance tant espérée, qu'elle les rouvre pour s'apercevoir qu'elle est revenue à ses 17 ans, à l'âge d'or de la secte Tang de Sichuan... ?!

description.en: The Taesung Gang was everything to its boss, Kang Deokbae. But his golden days come to an end on his 50th birthday, when a rival mob ambushes the gang and fatally injures him. After entrusting Taesung to his loyal subordinates, Deokbae closes his eyes and wakes up 30 years later as Lee Taejun, a 23-year-old gangster! And upon learning that his gang is no longer the upright group it once was, Deokbae swears to set things right... even if he must destroy Taesung from the ground up.

description.en:
After the final exams, everyone in the noticeably looser atmosphere of the school is planning and looking forward to summer vacation. Yujin, a sincere and good model student, is completely absorbed in an exchange diary.

The exchange diary is one that is passed back and forth daily through an empty locker, and the identity of the partner is kept secret. Yujin develops feelings for that partner and tries to arrange a meeting before summer vacation starts, while Sang-kyu grows increasingly worried about Yujin…

JD is a young boy raised by his grandfather to be the last hope for a world in conflict–but too bad nobody told JD! He's not the best student in school, and he's way more interested in the hottest new magical weapons than any conflict between good and evil. So when assassins from the Fourth World make their way up a living waterway to JD, will he learn to master the powers he's been entrusted with? Or will his adventure end before it begins?

description.en: Humanity has lost. By the end of World War Three, the R-virus has decimated 80% of the world’s population. To make matters worse, the virus transforms the infected into mindless monsters who crave human flesh, with some evolving into powerful beings with special powers called “Rayers”. The last remaining human settlements live in fear, their survival entirely dependent on the R-X, teenagers who have gained special abilities themselves through contact with Rayers. Wielding lethal weapons and supernatural abilities, the R-X fights to defend what little hope humanity has left.

이때 등장한 변종 R-바이러스는 인간을 잡아먹는 초능력 괴물 레이어를 탄생시킨다.

이들에 대항하기 위해 레이어의 하위호환 능력을 보유하게 된 10명의 전사 R-X!

이들의 손에 인류의 생존 멸망이 달려있다!

R-X에게 명령한다! 레이어로부터 인류를 구하라!
description.ru: Человечество проиграло. К концу Третьей мировой войны R-вирус уничтожил 80 % населения земного шара. Что еще хуже, вирус превращает инфицированных в безмозглых монстров, которые жаждут человеческой плоти, а некоторые превращаются в могущественных существ с особыми способностями, называемых “Райеры”. Последние оставшиеся человеческие поселения живут в страхе, их выживание полностью зависит от R-X, подростков, которые сами приобрели особые способности благодаря контакту с Райерами. Обладая смертоносным оружием и сверхъестественными способностями, R-X сражается, чтобы защитить ту малую надежду, которая осталась у человечества.

description.en:
Burned out from work, Yeonseul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. But as rescue brings an end to their rendezvous, Yeonseul reluctantly resigns herself to the end of her castaway romance–except her island husband doesn’t want to, their love story far from over.

----
*Note: The English adaptation is R15. The original work is R19.*

description.en:
Vivian awakens to find herself possessing the body of a terminally-ill female lead, doomed to a tragic ending. Refusing to accept that fate, Vivian seeks out Rahel, the story’s infamous villainess and the only person capable of curing her. What begins as a desperate gamble slowly turns into a genuine bond, and against all expectations, the two become close, true friends. But...

"Not for a single moment did I ever consider you my friend, Vivian."
"Do you really think you could enter a contract marriage with anyone else?"

...Wait. Wasn’t Rahel supposed to be a villainess?! My best friend just turned out to be a guy?!
description.ko: 하필이면 시한부 여자주인공에 빙의한 '비비안'.비비안은 자신의 새드 엔딩을 피하기 위해,유일한 치료제인 악녀 '라헬'에게 접근하여 그녀와 진정한 친구가 된다.하지만…“난 단 한 순간도 널 친구라고 생각한 적 없어, 비비안.”“다른 새끼랑 이런 걸 할 수 있겠어?”자, 잠깐만요. 악녀라더니?!내 단짝 친구가 남자가 되었습니다?
description.ru:
Вивиан, которая — надо же было такому случиться — очнулась в теле главной героини, чьи дни сочтены.

Чтобы избежать своего печального финала, Вивиан решает сблизиться со злодейкой Рашель — единственным человеком, который может стать её «лекарством». Она прилагает все усилия и становится её настоящей подругой. Но…

— Я ни единой секунды не считала тебя своей подругой, Вивиан.
— Ты смогла бы вытворять подобное с каким-нибудь другим ублюдком?

По-подождите... Вы же говорили, что она злодейка?!
Моя лучшая подруга оказалась мужчиной?

description.en: When Lord Dahn-Guh "accidentally" unleashes powerful demons unto the land, he orders the fool Ondal to recapture them! Unable to fulfil the task on his own, Ondal is accompanied by Hae-Moh-Soo–a legendary, foul-mouthed warrior who helped to trap the demons in the first place–and…David Copperfield?! Along the way, they come across quite the interesting array of characters: a gang of armed nuns, the mysterious Samson with singing powers, the twins Pai and Pei, and so many more!

The life of hottest girl in school is not easy. Sure, all the boys in school are in love with you, but that means that every girl in school is trying to destroy your life! Vicious rumors and gossip follow everywhere you go. But Hye-Min Hwang is not a delicate damsel in distress. She knows that there is nothing more satisfying than sweet revenge. That is, if it were not for her secret crush, Jung-Yun. He makes her want to hide her cynical dark side, put on an innocent, pretty face, and endure all the backstabbing lies. Then one day she finds out that he is the one guy in school who doesn’t like her anyway! It’s time for Hye-min’s sweet revenge, and her first victim will be Ma-Ha, a playboy who’s been begging for her attention for as long as she’s known him…

description.en: A little paper airplane, a magic academy, and two very different children. They make a promise at a young age–and seek to keep it once they're of age.

In 2097, an episode happened on an island called Utopia, built by solar power and by solar power. In a world where supernatural powers were naturally present, Vivi is a special case. Despite this, can Vivi preserve her peaceful day-to-day life?

Sangwoo -- a rich high school boy, meets Jinyeong and quickly deepens a new friendship. Sangwoo's friend starts to warn him to stay away from Jinyeong and that Jinyeong is using him . Sangwoo tries to find out more about Jinyeong’s hidden story with Jooyeoung -- their dead classmate!

Remember the story of the Frog Prince? A little girl kisses a frog to get back her ball, and ends up with a frog for a husband! Only after she’s completely ignored and abused him does she realize the frog has changed into a handsome prince. Miyoul is a feisty high schooler whose only thoughts are of the hottest boy in school, Guelin. But her childhood friend, Heerack, who acts as her personal lackey, is deeply in love with her. Will Miyoul be able to see which is the frog and which is her true prince?

The day after playing the ending of ‘D-Rank Hunter’s Regression,’ I found myself in the game when I woke up. Before I could find a way back to reality, I was kidnapped by the game’s protagonist, S-class Hunter Lee Jihee! After being blackmailed into signing a contract to become his exclusive supporter, or rather, his exclusive slave...

[Listen to your master’s words and become his beloved servant!]

“......Beloved- What? Master? What are you talking about?!”

Will Yeon Seon-woo be able to change this crazy fate?

Invest like a pro! The number of individuals investing in stocks is growing daily. But for every brilliant success story, there are countless failures. It isn’t easy for small investors to succeed in the ruthless world of stock trading. Still, it isn’t impossible — if you can just think like a quant!
Living Like a Flower revolves around a flower shop that is run by a father and his son. The story consists of various sub-plots with different casts.

The prince of heaven is punished after defiling a thousand girls!  
  
Meanwhile, a nine-tailed fox has always wanted to be human. She's waited a thousand years to have a flowery romance on earth. However, when she gets there–surrounded by manic obsessive school-girls, she realizes earth isn't what she's always dreamed of. Especially when there's a boy named "Cha Ga-Un" who ultimately gives heartache to all the girls he meets!

biography.en: Not an actual artist, but a pseudonym created by the Korean magazine Kkotnim to publish a mass amount of "house style" manhwa.

description.en:
Choi "Rotten Tooth" Choong Chi just wants to be left alone so that he can study like his mommy told him too. His life-long ambition is to be ranked first academically in school. Unfortunately for him, he's also a brilliant fighter, coveted (or targeted) by every gang that crosses his path.  
  
After transferring to the prestigious Yong Yong High School from the delinquent-ridden 88 Academy, Rotten Tooth also makes a new discovery: girls, and to top it all off, the prettiest and smartest girl in the school, Yeon Doo. Too bad his main rival Jang Bogo is also after the same girl.  
  
Can our hero get the girl? Can he even survive high school with his life and limbs intact?

The girl group, 'Lily', who was selected by the Global Idol audition, fell into despair due to a voting manipulation scandal right before its debut. Cha Yoo-joo, Korea's best entertainment representative, who "planned" this, was framed and betrayed by her husband before bring sentenced to life in prison. Eunha-rin is a visual center and former gangster, who she met during her time in prison. Cha Yoo-joo thus convinces her and once again, makes her debut with Lily.
description.ko:
글로벌 아이돌 오디션에서 발탁된 걸그룹 '릴리'는 데뷔 직전 투표조작으로 나락에 떨어지고,
이를 기획한 대한민국 최고의 엔터테인먼트 대표 차유주는 남편의 배신으로 누명을 쓰며 징역을 살게 된다.
수감 중 만난 조폭 출신의 비주얼센터감 은하린. 차유주는 그녀를 꼬셔 다시금 릴리를 데뷔시키는데...

Two days ago something happened to Seong-Won while visiting his friend Hyo-Jun house, something that caused him to not to sleep since then. Will a meeting on the train with Hyo-Jun's older sister reveal what happened?

In search of perfect love, 16 men and women participate in the dating reality program "Paradise on Earth." With sparkling blue seas and warm sunshine 365 days a year, this place is a paradise-like island.

However, in the second week of filming, the staff members infected with an unknown virus begin to show strange phenomena, and paradise turns into hell in an instant. All contact between the island and the outside world is cut off, and rescue efforts are out of reach. Will they be able to survive to the end?

Louri is a witch. She wasn't always a witch, however; an incident caused her to be this way. And a long, long time ago she cast a curse on her beloved which makes him turn into a swan for the daytime. The only way to get him back to the way he was before is a kiss from his beloved. description.en: One day a young girl finds out that the boy she likes is going to transfer to a different school. The only one who knows how much she loves him is her diary.

The snowman maiden, whose soul has entered a human body, Seolha! However, her body melts when it becomes hot. Her first love has endured for no less than a hundred years.

There is only one way for Seolha to become human—she must succeed in love?!

However, unlike in her affectionate past life, Yiram doesn't understand Seolha's feelings. Even the god, Woojo, who used to argue every day, is showing an attitude quite different from before.

Will Seolha be able to safely find success in love?!

Beautiful, wealthy, and smart, Yeori Cheon is a chaebol heiress cursed with the ability to see ghosts. In order to appease the restless spirits, she secretly helps them find their missing bodies. When she meets Gang-uk Ma, a prosecutor investigating unsolved murder cases, the two join forces to solve paranormal cases. As they confront increasingly dangerous cases, an unexpected romance begins to blossom.
description.ko:
완벽한 재벌 상속녀 천여리. 손이 닿는 사람까지 귀신을 보게 만드는 저주를 지녔다.
시신 유기 현장에서 엮인 열혈 검사 마강욱은 여리의 '실수' 한 번으로 귀신이 보게 되는데…
귀신을 막으려면 밀착, 정체를 숨기려면 위장 약혼까지?
공조는 점점 위험해지고, 심장은 점점 가까워진다.
귀신보다 더 위험한 두 사람의 달콤살벌 공조 로맨스!

description.en:
Geonyeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons. Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geonyeong's journey to prove that despite the disadvantages life has dealt her, she is worthy of respect.

(Source: Naver)
description.es:
Geonyeong es una chica brillante. A pesar de proceder de un entorno desfavorecido, su excepcional inteligencia le permite matricularse en el prestigioso instituto Pyeonghyeon. Allí conoce a nuevos rivales y amigos. Le cuesta mucho competir con el resto de alumnos privilegiados que reciben costosas clases particulares. En medio de estos retos, está decidida a triunfar y convertirse en jueza. Este es el viaje de Geonyeong para demostrar que, a pesar de las desventajas que la vida le ha deparado, es digna de respeto.


(Fuente: Naver)
description.id: Kwak Gunyoung, seorang anak dan ayah yang dipenjara ini menyadari bahwa di dunia yang tidak adil ini, ada tuntutan khusus dari anak keturunan orang berada. Seperti anak jaksa dan keluarga terpandang yang selalu diharapkan menjadi anak yang memberikan "lebih"; Lebih pintar, lebih sopan, hingga masa depan yang lebih cerah. Sebagai anak dari keluarga "rendahan", ternyata Gunyoung merupakan anak genius yang jauh lebih pintar dari anak seusianya. Bagaimana Gunyoung menjalani kehidupan "tidak adil"nya itu dengan bakat yang ia punya?
description.ko:
불우한 환경에서도 탁월함을 타고난 건영. 
일류대 출신 판검사를 목표로 입학한 명문 고등학교에서는 자꾸만 건영의 품위를 위협하는 일이 생기는데⋯⋯.
description.ru:
Гонён — одарённая девушка из бедной семьи. Благодаря своему выдающимся уму она поступает в элитную школу «Пхёнхён», где сталкивается с совершенно другим миром. Здесь у её новых одноклассников есть всё: деньги, связи, частные учителя. А у Гонён — только упорство и жажда справедливости.

Ей предстоит нелегкая борьба — не только за оценки, но и за своё место в этом мире привилегий. Но Гонён не сдаётся. Её цель — стать судьёй и доказать, что достоинство человека не измеряется толщиной кошелька.

Это история о том, как талант и упорство побеждают обстоятельства. История о том, почему важно бороться — даже когда весь мир против тебя.
description.zh:
困境压不垮她的梦
暗潮中绽放真锋芒
出身贫寒的天才少女，为成为顶尖法官踏入名门学府，却在光鲜背后遭遇暗潮与挑战。她用智慧与勇气，一步步在竞争中闯出属于自己的天地。
description.pt-br:
Geonyeong é uma garota brilhante. Apesar de vir de uma família humilde, sua inteligência excepcional lhe permite ingressar na prestigiada Escola de Ensino Médio Pyeonghyeon.
Lá, ela conhece novos rivais e amigos. Ela enfrenta dificuldades para competir com os outros alunos privilegiados, que têm acesso a aulas particulares caras e diversos recursos educacionais.
Em meio a esses desafios, Geonyeong está determinada a alcançar o sucesso e se tornar uma juíza. Esta é a jornada de Geonyeong para provar que, apesar das desvantagens que a vida lhe impôs, ela merece respeito e reconhecimento.
description.zh-hk: 即使在惡劣的環境中，健英在學業上的表現依舊十分卓越。 而她以名校畢業的法官和檢察官為目標，進入了一所知名高中。 然而，在這裡卻不斷發生各種事件，動搖著健英的價值與尊嚴⋯

description.en: Yang Sohwa could see ghosts ever since she was little. For the past few years her visions have stopped, but now they are reappearing and she’s about to find out the tragedy that occurred hundreds of years ago on her school grounds.
Eight years ago, three people who grew apart after confessions. Now, my first love and the one who I said was the first love and I now share a home! Three people's strange lives.

title.en: Pigeon Lee Heon-Seo of Seongbuk District

description.en:
'Lee Heonseo' (F, 24), a university student, turned into a pigeon one morning.
Unable to find a way to turn back into a human, Heonseo begins to live with a male friend of hers from the same neighborhood, 'Ban Hwihyeol.’

How is it, Miss Lee Heonseo, is life as a pigeon fun?
description.ko:
하루 아침에 비둘기가 되어버린 대학생 '이헌서'(여/24)
다시 인간으로 돌아갈 방법을 찾지 못한 헌서는 당분간 같은 동네 남사친 '반휘혈'의 집에 머물며 비둘기 생활을 이어나가게 되는데...

어떤가요 이헌서양, 비둘기 생활 재미있나요?

title.en: My Husband Is Weak by Day, Strong by Night

altTitles.fr: Mon mari: faible de jour, imparable la nuit

altTitles.ja: 嫁ぎ先は病弱な皇帝でした

altTitles.vi: Tôi Đã Kết Hôn Với Một Người Chồng Ốm Yếu

description.en: Meredith is the illegitimate daughter of a duke. Scorned by her own family, she is shocked to hear that they have arranged a marriage for her—with no other than the Emperor of Valtzein. She soon learns that His Majesty has been placed under a curse and is weak during the day, returning to his former self only at night. When he tries to kill her on their wedding night, she strikes a deal with him—she will find a way to use her healing magic to break him free from the curse, in return for a divorce. But the Emperor has other thoughts—he's slowly fallen in love with her, and he won't let her go without a fight.
description.fr: Meredith est la fille illégitime d'un duc. D'habitude traitée comme une moins que rien par sa propre famille, elle est choquée d'apprendre qu'ils ont arrangé un mariage avec l'empereur de Valtzein pour elle. Elle apprend rapidement que Sa Majesté a été victime d'une malédiction et qu'il est faible le jour, ne retrouvant sa force originelle que la nuit. Alors qu'il s'apprétait à la tuer lors de leur nuit de noces, elle conclut un marché avec lui: elle trouvera un moyen d'utiliser sa magie de soin pour le libérer de sa malédiction, en échange d'un divorce. Mais l'Empereur a d'autres idées en tête: il tombe peu à peu sous son charme et ne la laissera pas partir sans se battre...
description.ja:
シュワーツ公爵家の婚外子、メレディス。
ある日突然、婚外子だという理由で病弱な皇帝に嫁ぐことになった。
結婚式で初めて会った皇帝は、今にも倒れそうで初夜も送れないと思っていたのに…。
結婚初夜に見た彼は刺客を殺せるほど強かった。
昼は病弱だけど夜は元気になる夫…!?
黒呪術をかけられている彼の病を治せるのは、治癒力を持っている私だけ。
私を殺そうとした彼にそう提案し、それを理由に契約をしたのだが…。
生き延びるためには黒呪術を解かないといけないのに、果たしてメレディスは無事に治すことができるのか？
description.ko:
[병약하다고 소문난 황제 남편의 충격적인 진실] 

집안의 애물단지로 키워진 사생아, 메레디스. 
권력에 눈이 먼 아버지로 인해 병약한 황제에게 팔려가듯 시집을 가 버렸다. 
서있는 것조차 힘들다고 하니 분명 초야도 제대로 못 치르겠지. 
그러나 신방에서 본 건… 

"들켜 버렸네. 안 올 줄 알았는데." 

사방에 쓰러진 암살자들과 피를 잔뜩 뒤집어 쓴 채 내게 검을 겨누는 남편이었다. 
병약한 거 아니었어? 왜 멀쩡한 건데?! 
나를 단단히 오해하고 있는 이 남자는 사실 흑주술로 인해 병치레를 앓고 있었다. 

"제가… 폐하의 병을 낫게 해 드릴 수 있다면요?" 
"아무 말이나 한다고 살려주겠다는 뜻이 아니였는데." 

당장이라도 날 죽일듯 바라보는 남편에게서 살아남으려면 
내가 숨겨왔던 능력을 써서라도 그를 치유해야 한다. 
그렇게 목숨을 담보로 한 계약을 맺었는데… 

"나는 그대가 필요해. 어쩌면 영원히…" 

어째 내 남편이 건강해지다 못해 달라진 것 같다. 
저희, 계약 관계 아니었나요?
description.zh: 因为是私生子就被嫁给了体弱多病的皇帝，本以为连一夜缠绵都不会有... 可是在新婚卧室里看到把暗杀者打倒，将剑指向我的丈夫！ 说好的体弱多病呢？

description.en: Crime lord Yoonshik takes a little boy named Jiwoon as collateral when the child's father hangs himself from debt. Eight years later, the boy is working as Yoonshik's bodyguard. When the boss gets locked behind bars, Jiwoon is sent to work for another middle boss in the city's red-light district. There, Jiwoon meets a mysterious mute, Soohan, and everything just might change for him.
description.pt-br: O senhor do crime Yoonshik leva um menino chamado Jiwoon como garantia quando o pai da criança se mata por causa de uma divida. Oito anos depois, o menino está trabalhando como guarda-costas de Yoonshik. Quando o patrão vai parar atrás das grades, Jiwoon é enviado para trabalhar para outro chefe no distrito da luz vermelha. Lá, Jiwoon encontra um mudo misterioso, Soohan, e tudo pode mudar para ele.

description.en:
In the ultimate dating game mayhem, Jerry Route's virtual love life takes center stage! 

Battling fainting spells due to his feeble stats, Jerry's three brothers crank up the competition for his affection. Enter the swoon-worthy crown prince Karyan and the fourth prince Ilya, who both vie for Jerry's attention. It's a hilarious, heart-fluttering quest as Jerry dodges the overprotective antics of friends and family, navigating the game while encountering an amusing array of characters. 

Will Jerry find true love amidst the chaos, or will his frailty throw a comical wrench into his romantic escapades?

A student is found dead at St. Adella Girls' School, where attendance is strictly confined to ladies of the upper class. Although it resembles a suicide at first glance, Emily, the victim's best friend, is certain it was murder. After much consideration, Emily asks her now estranged childhood friend Irene, the smartest student in the school, to investigate the case...

title.en: The Male Lead Is Obsessed With Proposing to Me

description.en:
Trapped in a story where the male lead must love her to survive, a woman dedicates eight years to manipulating his heart — silent stalking, strategic appearances, engineered coincidences. 

But when her coldly planned "happy ending" arrives, she learns a hard lesson: you can't control love without losing yourself.

Three years ago in Spain, Chaewon had to break up with her boyfriend, Seongjun Han, because her father collapsed after his company went bankrupt. In order to pay the debt her father owes to his former employees and loan sharks, she decides to take part in a posthumous marriage for 200 million won. As a condition for the marriage, she’s not allowed to date anyone for 1,000 days. On her wedding day, she runs into Seongjun, who still has feelings for her, and now she has to work part-time at his company for three months.
Slacker revolves around a girl named Song Ah-Ram who is an extreme slacker and her roommate Choe Yun-Mi who suffers because of her.

High school girl Yoo Eun Bi becomes obsessed with ballroom dancing after watching a ballroom dancing competition. Her passion drives her to form a ballroom dancing club in school, but it isn’t as easy as it seems. Not only is the school refusing to fund the club, but model student Kang Woon is set on making Eun Bi’s life hell.  
  
While struggling to form the club, she finds out Kang Woon’s darkest secret. He leads a double life, balancing between being a top student in school and a devious dancer during the night. With the help of Kang Woon, will Eun Bi finally be able to accomplish her goal?

title.en: Puss in Suit, Pup in Tie

description.en: Sunwoo looks like a harmless little puppy on the outside, but everyone in the office knows he's more of a feisty cat - sensitive and aloof, through and through. Hyunjin, on the other hand, is like a big friendly dog - always ready and oh-so-eager to befriend Sunwoo. After his fruitless efforts to avoid Hyunjin within the office, Sunwoo gives him an ultimatum that results in their unlikely new friendship. Rocky roads await the puss in suit and pup in tie!

A hot and handsome young man that can capture the heart of any woman caught the innocent love of a fellow worker.  
On the other hand, a mysterious woman that claims she would never fall for a man comforts her best friend.  
What will happen when these two lives clash into one another at a fateful meeting? Will this mysterious woman change her ways?

Handsome and tall Seo Ji-Uoo always gets mistaken for a boy. When an old childhood friend transfers into her class, he immediately wants to be friends with her. But Seo Ji-Uoo's best friend doesn't seem to like that idea.  

---
**Note:**
- This oneshot won the grand prize at the 36th Daiwon Super Manhwa Contest.

title.en: How Sweet is a Sugar Daddy

description.en:
Sihoon is handsome, cultured and rich. What else would you expect from an established doctor? He's everything that Junyoung wants to be, once he gets out of college.  
  
Oh, and Junyoung's not gay. At least, that's what he says… while he's more or less having sex with Sihoon. A man. A married man. A married man who happens to be dating his his best friend, Mari.

"Yoonjae," who's in their first year of being a solo act and doesn't like dating, but still wants physical affection, encounters the arrival of "Minseok" at their company, who seems popular with everyone. 

Minseok suggests going out for drinks separately with Yoonjae, but there are no texts asking if Yoonjae got home safely. Minseok's attitude is ambiguous, mixing pleasant words with drawing boundaries. 

They share meals, watch movies, and have physical contact, yet they're not officially dating. What kind of relationship are we in? Something other than dating for us in our 30s.

While visiting Gyeongbokgung palace, Jian is struck by lightning and passes out. When she awakens, to her shock, she finds herself stuck in the distant past of South Korea. Forced into a different period, she learns to embrace a new life and finds a new love!

Se Woong became middle-aged without any proper confession to his first love. In his dried up life, Yoo Il, who is brightness and youth himself, appears. But, he is the son of his friend… and that friend of his was Se Woong’s first love.
A Korean language teacher who cares about Korean too much, and a girl who loves such a teacher.

Summary: I, Yang Jeonghyun the master of the martial arts, one day becomes a fool in another world… "Me", which is the strongest in my original world, suddenly has to endure all sorts of contempt and humiliation in this new world. But "I" will fight against them and never give up. I will not stop reaching my goal until the day climb to the top and put the world under my feet!

Unknown Caller is an app-exclusive horror anthology with stories from renowned Korean creators who have been scaring audiences for years. These stories use augmented reality to unveil the creatures that haunt your home.

description.ko: 성공한 인생을 위해 목숨 걸고 일해 온 직장인, 이도윤. 그토록 꿈꾸던 성공 라인을 타며 궤도에 오르기 시작한 그는 긴장의 끈을 놓치고 무방비로 취한 밤을 보내게 되는데...

description.en: A gripping reinterpretation/adaptation of The Illiad by Homer that revolves around Priam's daughter, Cassandra, who was believed to have been given the gift of prophecy by Apollo when he proposed to her.

title.en: THE iDOLM@STER - Your Melody, My Melody (Doujinshi)

description.en: A Korean Doujinshi. Read Left to Right.

Tomboy Mi-Ha is an extremely active and competitive girl who never likes to lose to anyone. She's such a tomboy that all boys are scared of her, and that's exactly what her brother wanted and trained her to be. It took him six long years to train her into a pseudo-military style girl to protect her from anyone else. Bishonen Sung-Suh is a new transfer student who's got the looks, the determination, and attitude to sweep her off the feet. Could this male beauty be able to tame the beast? Will Miha's brother let them be together and happily ever after? If you want it you've got to Bring It On!

Kind brothers like in dramas or movies don’t exist. This is a real sibling story. A real-life Oppa is here!  
  
Oppa (오빠) is the term for "older brother" used by females in Korean.

Tae Min-hyuk, a cold celebrity, accidentally falls into the sea while filming and barely survive by being saved by a woman, Oh Seol-hwa.

After that, Tae Min-hyuk fell in love with Oh Seol-hwa at first glance after seeing.
Mankind has a strong tendency to repeat past mistakes … Will the history repeat again?

title.en: Daily Life of a Demon Dad

description.en: Will, the sole survivor of a demonic race, meets Elly, a lonely girl who has nowhere to go. This odd match ends up becoming the most precious family bond.
